message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 (C allele) in European populations**

| Source | Population | Minor allele frequency (MAF) |
|--------|------------|------------------------------|
| gnomAD v2.1.1 (non‑Finnish Europeans) | EUR | **≈ 0.12** (12 %) |
| 1000 Genomes Project (EUR) | EUR | **≈ 0.11–0.13** (11–13 %) |

**Key points**

- rs7412 is one of the two SNPs that define the APOE ε2/ε3/ε4 alleles.  
- The C allele (minor allele) is present in roughly 12 % of European chromosomes; the T allele is the major allele (~88 %).  
- Frequencies can vary slightly among sub‑populations (e.g., higher in Southern Europeans, lower in Northern Europeans), but the overall range remains ~10–13 %.  

**Reference**  
gnomAD Browser (v2.1.1) – “Non-Finnish European” allele counts for rs7412. 1000 Genomes Phase 3 – EUR allele counts.
